quote: Significant association with TLE has been reported in four genes: IL-1b (Kanemoto et al., 2000), PDYN (Stogmann et al., 2002), GABBR1 (Gambardella et al., 2003a) and PRNP (Walz et al., 2003). One study has reported an association of APOE with age of onset of TLE (Briellmann et al., 2000). In addition, variants in CHRNA4 (Chou et al., 2003a) and GABRG2 (Chou et al., 2003b) have been reported as risk factors for childhood FS. ... Here we have examined all seven claims of positive association (for TLE and FS) in the literature by attempting to replicate them
notes: Seven primary claims (Kanemoto 2000, Stogmann 2002, Gambardella 2003a, Walz 2003, Briellmann 2000, Chou 2003a CHRNA4, Chou 2003b GABRG2). Also explicitly re-tested secondary IL-1b associations: Virta 2002, Kanemoto 2003 (FS) and Peltola 2001 (refractory partial epilepsy). Key mapping trap: paper's Chou 2003a (CHRNA4) = @chou2003b; Chou 2003b (GABRG2) = @chou2003; paper's Gambardella 2003a (GABBR1) = @gambardella2003 (not @gambardella2003b, PDYN follow-up).
